gameDescription: Winter, 1893. Monster hunter Liv Ravn returns to the isolated Scandinavian valley of Vargdal after every church bell rings simultaneously. A dark-fantasy action slasher featuring responsive 3-hit combos, charged heavy thrusts, dodge invulnerability, directional parries, iron ward projectiles, checkpoints at iron prayer posts, Rend executions, four distinct enemy archetypes, two minibosses, and a 3-phase final boss fight beneath a colossal suspended cracked bronze bell.
